ai_summary: Agarwal Industrial Corporation Ltd. reported its Q1 FY2026 unaudited financial results and proposed a dividend of INR 3.30 per share for FY2025-26, pending shareholder approval. The Board also approved a significant strategic diversification into infrastructure development, EPC, broader chemical trading, and related services, necessitating a material alteration to its Memorandum of Association. Investors should scrutinize the proposed remuneration for advisory services to a non-independent director, categorized as a related party transaction, detailed in the upcoming Annual General Meeting notice.
